purpose.content: This function example defines an in-memory boundary with no execution claim.

fields.purpose: Construct an in-memory run for a validated plan.

contract.content: Invalid inputs are refused before a run is constructed.

fields.inputs: One caller-owned plan with a nonempty ordered stage list.
fields.outputs: A new run at its first stage; ownership transfers to the caller.
fields.errors: InvalidPlan when the stage list is empty or repeats an identifier.
fields.side_effects: Not applicable: this fictional function does not persist data or invoke callbacks.

behavior.content: The stated invariant constrains the fictional transition.

fields.behavior: Validate the plan, then construct the initial run.
fields.invariants: An invalid plan never produces a run.
fields.constraints: The caller serializes access; concurrency is outside this example.
